sources.snippet: ComfyUI Bernini v2 Native ComfyUI implementation of ByteDance/Bernini-Diffusers-v2. The official ByteDance implementation is the numerical oracle. It is not a runtime dependency of this project. The runtime target is ComfyUI's own model loading, device management, conditioning, guider, scheduler and sampling APIs.
